- Phosphorus (P): Left side has 2 atoms, right side has x atoms (in xPH3). So x must equal 2 for balance.
- Hydrogen (H): Left side has 6 atoms (in 3H2O), right side has 3x atoms (in xPH3). If x = 2, then right side has 6 hydrogen atoms, which balances.
